    """Return True if number passes the Luhn check.

    The input is a string. Single spaces between digits are allowed and
    ignored. After removing spaces, the string must contain at least two
    characters, all of which are ASCII digits 0-9; otherwise return False.
    """
    digits = number.replace(' ', '')

    if len(digits) < 2:
        return False

    for ch in digits:
        if ch < '0' or ch > '9':
            return False

    total = 0
    parity = len(digits) % 2
    for i, ch in enumerate(digits):
        value = ord(ch) - ord('0')
        if i % 2 == parity:
            value *= 2
            if value > 9:
                value -= 9
        total += value

    return total % 10 == 0
